mir.text: Kush is a city of magical duels where Garth arrives, allies with the old thief Hammen and earns the name One-Eye in a public duel.
After Zarel captures and tortures him, Hammen, Norreen and Varena free Garth, who reveals he is a survivor of the destroyed Fifth House and enters the Arena under its banner, sparking chaos.
Garth wins the tournament, and the city erupts in open rebellion, ending when he returns and drives a dagger into Zarel's heart.
Three years later the city is rebuilt as Estark, with Hammen and Naru as Masters of their Houses and the resurrected Varena as Grand Master.
